patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within full-width sections, which alternate between a dark blue-grey and a light off-white background for visual segmentation.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for section titles and smaller, lighter sans-serif text for body content. Code snippets are presented in a distinct monospace font.

The palette is restrained, primarily using a dark blue-grey for hero and code blocks, a light off-white for most content areas, and a vibrant blue for interactive elements like links and call-to-action buttons.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to site navigation.
Extensive use of dedicated sponsor and backer sections, categorized by contribution tier, each featuring a dense grid of logos and a clear call-to-action to 'Become a Sponsor' or 'Backer'.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that remains visible at the top of the screen, ensuring global navigation is always accessible. Content sections simply scroll vertically into and out of view without additional scroll-triggered animations or reveals.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are significantly larger and bolder (~3-4x body) than the body text, establishing a strong visual hierarchy, while body text maintains high legibility.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp corners for general elements, with subtle rounding applied to buttons and code block containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced vertical spacing between major content sections, creating an airy feel, contrasted with dense, grid-like arrangements for sponsor and backer logos.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its highly functional and informative presentation, particularly the prominent, illustrative hero diagram explaining its core function and the extensive, categorized display of community support through sponsor and backer logos. It effectively balances technical detail with community engagement.
